page_for_python.no_re_draw: A different S5 draw might title capability:3 with terms its own citations carry. That is what selecting for a seal looks like: the defect is that the two checks disagree on their standard, and a lucky title hides it rather than fixing it.

proposals.defect: plan_checks judges a capability title's format terms against EVERY format fact in the document (recorded = {fact.value: fact.polarity for fact in facts.by_kind('format')}), while authoring.py::unit_checks (lines 1099-1118) judges the SAME title against only the values of that slot's own planned fact_ids. The narrower standard is applied second, at S6, where neither the title nor the citation set can be changed - so a plan passes S5 carrying a slot no unit can fill. The planning check's own comment states the purpose it fails to serve: 'S6 judges the same titles by the same rule ..., but by then the plan is fixed ... Asked here, the model can choose another title.'
proposals.repository_and_finding: aspose-page-foss/Aspose.Page-FOSS-for-Python at ca4fb3d7; 'unit capability:3: its title "Author PS/EPS and XPS documents" names .eps, which the facts it cites do not carry', twice, run ended.
proposals.proposed_shape: plan_checks applies authoring.py's standard: each capability's title terms must be carried by the values of THAT capability's own fact_ids, plus the identity/package neutrals and the product name. The planner is then told at S5, where it can retitle or add public_symbol:aspose.page.ps.image_to_eps to the slot - both its own to do, neither of them S6's.
proposals.explicitly_not_proposed: NO relaxation of the slot-set rule (section 27.2 RC2: overlapping slot fact sets mean the title is the only separator), NO relaxation of the title rule, and NO permission for S6 to add facts the plan did not assign.

proposals.defect: CLONE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 600.0 is one constant for a portfolio spanning 1.4 MB to 409 MB, and each of RETRY_POLICIES['clone']'s three attempts starts from an empty directory (force_rmtree on failure), so a large clone under link contention can never converge: the budget resets instead of accumulating and 30 minutes buys three partial copies of the same objects.
proposals.repository_and_finding: aspose-page-foss/Aspose.Page-FOSS-for-Python; 'clone ... failed after 3 attempts: transient clone failure ... timed out after 600.0s', twice (2026-09-11 and 2026-09-16).
proposals.proposed_shape: Stop discarding the partial clone: retry into the same directory (a git fetch --depth 1 onto the partial repository rather than a fresh clone) so a second attempt continues where the first stopped.
proposals.explicitly_not_proposed: NO raise of CLONE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS (section 27.10 - a threshold is never fitted to two samples) and NO relaxation of the revision-pin check, which is what makes the clone trustworthy.
